note: Hôtel des Voyageurs rooftop terrace (top floor, reached only by the interior stairs), view east over the roofs to the harbour. Landmark: the blue-and-white striped awning. Feminine LEFT: family with old suitcases and a trunk waving goodbye to the steamship in the harbour (émigration), sleepy gentleman strolling in blue flannel pyjamas (flânerie). Centre: innkeeper in an aubergine hat with a tray of lemonade (aubergiste, m/f). Masculine RIGHT: old pilgrim with staff, scallop-shell hat and gourd (pèlerinage, reverent), lass polishing a model of a gold-domed luxury seafront hotel (palace), duck swimming a long loop in the round pool (périple). Exits: stair kiosk door (near left) -> stairs down to R_hotel_02; turquoise arched door of the rooftop spa (far right) -> hammam R_hotel_03_z1. Painted 2026-10-22.
